description: This file defines the ManufacturerService interface, which declares methods for managing manufacturer entities, including listing, saving, deleting, and querying manufacturers related to stores, languages, categories, and products within the system.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers for a given store and language, throws ServiceException on error.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers for a given store, without specifying language, throws ServiceException on error.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a manufacturer entity.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Associates a ManufacturerDescription with a Manufacturer entity.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the count of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified manufacturer from the system.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products from categories specified by their IDs within a store and language context.
